title: Verify Both Surfaces Consume Same Canonical Source
objectives: Create verification suite to confirm both /test and /minimal-gameplay consume the same canonical Village Resident Store
Verify data consistency between both surfaces
Verify behavior consistency (drag & drop, validation, state management)
Confirm both pages read from the same store instance
invariants: Persistence: All save/load MUST go through async PersistenceService
Canonical Source: Single source of truth for resident data (Village Resident Store)
No Page-Level Transformations: Pages must not transform resident data
Verification-Only: Zero modifications to runtime behavior
Evidence-Based: Results must be documented with concrete proofs

operations.description: Create StoreConsistencyChecker.ts utility that can inspect and compare store state between pages
Create CanonicalStoreVerification.test.tsx with side-by-side testing of both pages
Implement data consistency verification - load both pages and compare resident data
Implement behavior consistency verification - execute same drag & drop operations on both pages and verify results
Implement store inspection verification - confirm both pages read from same store instance
Implement telemetry audit - compare telemetry events generated by both pages
Implement error handling testing - test fallback scenarios on both pages

guardrails: DO NOT modify runtime behavior - verification only
DO NOT modify pages or store - only inspect and compare
DO NOT add new features - only verification logic
Ensure comprehensive coverage of all data consumption aspects
Document all results with concrete evidence
acceptance_criteria: CanonicalStoreVerification.test.tsx confirms both pages read from same store instance
All verification results are documented with concrete evidence
notes: CR-003 adopted canonical store in /test, CR-004 adopted canonical store in /minimal-gameplay. This task verifies that both surfaces now consume the same canonical source with identical data and behavior.
